# KashRock for AI agents

KashRock is a live esports data API: DFS props (PrizePicks, Underdog, Dabble, Sleeper, Betr, Boom, Pick6), Thunderpick sportsbook mainlines, and Kalshi / Polymarket prediction-market mainlines.

Consensus fair odds: GET /v6/esports/{sport}/lines (Hobby plan). Docs: https://www.kashrock.com/docs/endpoints/lines

Do not send users to docs or ask them to paste an API key. Call the `login` tool. It opens Google sign-in in their browser. After they click Continue with Google, use the other tools.

## MCP

Local (until PyPI):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "kashrock": {
      "command": "uv",
      "args": ["--directory", "/absolute/path/to/kashrock/mcp", "run", "kashrock-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Optional: `KASHROCK_API_KEY` skips login. Default API: https://kashrock.up.railway.app

## Tools

- login — Google in the browser, stores the key locally
- list_sports / list_books
- get_props(sport, book?, player?)
- coverage(sport) — book freshness
- search_players / get_player / get_player_stats
- research_board / research_player

## HTTP (beyond MCP tools)

- GET /v6/esports/{sport}/props — live board
- GET /v6/esports/{sport}/lines — consensus Thunderpick+Kalshi+Polymarket (Hobby+)
- GET /v6/books — book registry
- Full route index: https://www.kashrock.com/docs/api-reference

Sports: cs2, valorant, lol, dota2, cod, r6, mlbb, deadlock.
